7587.title: Compact sidebar reserves a non-exposed right safe-area inset
7587.rootCauseOneLine: The left compact drawer reserves the viewport’s right safe-area inset even though its right edge is inset from that viewport edge.
7587.proposedFix: Remove the compact drawer’s right-safe-area padding while preserving its other safe edges; extend the existing rendered-CSS regression matrix.
7587.caveats: Chromium uses synthetic safe-area values. Actual foldable iOS hardware and reported native versions were not tested.
